episodeTitle: When Criticism Becomes a Spiritual Threat
episodeDescription: John & Brantley examine a 138-page document defending Mike & interpreting him as the “Kansas City Star.” Their discussion considers comparisons with Jesus, language that frames criticism as spiritual opposition, & questions about accountability within IHOP KC & emerging splinter groups. Drawing on John's recollections of belief in Branham, they explore how coincidences can become perceived confirmation, why failed predictions may leave loyalty intact, & how recognizable names can lend credibility to extraordinary claims. The conversation also examines the tension between affirming someone's worth & evaluating their conduct.
